title: A divisor of a nonzero constant multivariable polynomial is constant
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative integral domain, let $J$ be any set, and put $A=R[X_j:j\in J]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Write $C:R\to A$ for the constant-polynomial embedding. For $f\in A$ and $a\in R$ with $a\ne0$, one has $f\mid C(a)$ if and only if there exists $b\in R$ such that $b\mid a$ in $R$ and $f=C(b)$. Here $x\mid y$ means that $y=xz$ for some element $z$ of the indicated ring.
